title: FinTFM: a tabular foundation model for corporate credit risk, pretrained only on synthetic data
description:
An in-context tabular classifier for corporate credit risk, pretrained exclusively on synthetic data and never on real tables. Prediction is a single forward pass with the user's table supplied as context; there are no gradient steps at fit time and no per-dataset tuning.

The repository is organised around a numbered measurement log and a claims ledger that record retractions and superseded results as prominently as confirmations. Measured externally on TabArena it places 93rd of 95; on real corporate-default panels its calibration is consistently among the best measured while its discrimination consistently loses to tuned gradient boosting. Both facts are reported together.

Code and the published binary checkpoint are Apache-2.0.
